qualification: Source-bound graph Model proposal only. The exact original source, frontmatter, init theme, and accessibility facts remain attached per case. The graph Model is derived from source syntax; Class285 mapping review and native/official consumers have not admitted these four rows. No drawing credit is claimed.

independent_model_basis.derivation: Class source lines and operator tokens, not terminal output or a producer snapshot.
independent_model_basis.entity_identity: class:<lowercase UTF-8 hex of source class identity>
independent_model_basis.entity_creation_order: first source reference in relation statements, then source class declarations; fixed complete order retained in Model.
independent_model_basis.member_order: source order within Animal, Duck, Fish, and Zebra; each literal display spelling retained.
independent_model_basis.relation_order: all 19 relation occurrences in complete source order; repeated endpoint pairs are not deduplicated.

relation_operator_mapping.source_side: <| triangle; < arrow; * filled diamond; o open diamond
relation_operator_mapping.target_side: |> triangle; > arrow; * filled diamond; o open diamond
relation_operator_mapping.quoted_endpoint_text: source and target multiplicity text retained separately, without quote delimiters

independent_model_basis.scope_boundary: YAML description and init theme remain source-owned metadata; accTitle/accDescr are retained but not represented by the Class graph Model.

source_semantics_blocking_safe_whole_mod.detail: The source has nonempty accTitle and accDescr. The existing Class285 authority records both as unresolved; the graph schema has no approved accessibility projection.

The four init themes are distinct source facts. The reusable Class285 geometry oracle validates glyph cells and source lifecycle but not terminal color/style output; theme-specific visual fidelity is therefore unproved.

source_binding.existing_authority: OfficialClass285 source facts and original manifest bindings
required_checks: global ordinal and application ordinal map to exact row
path, bytes, source SHA256, Git blob, complete source string match pinned source row
frontmatter and init directive are included in the whole source pin
shared 789-byte graph body hash matches all four cases
source_binding.current_result: not executed by Native/Official consumers for this proposal

reusable_control_plan.model_codec: class481_model(model, work, endpoint_text_profile=true); then validate complete Model key/domain and canonical digest.

geometry_and_lifecycle.oracle: Existing Official Class285 stage_c_geometry + shared validate_impl using captured FTXUI Screen::PixelAt character Grid.
required_positive: wide and restored complete graph geometry and following sentinel pass
narrow complete graph geometry passes or its exact permitted source fallback is explicitly recorded
restored cells equal original wide cells
no source fallback earns drawing credit
geometry_and_lifecycle.unclaimed: This plan has not run; it does not prove geometry or colors.

semantic_mutations.reusable_oracle: class481_mutations on the complete source-bound Model and actual wide Grid; resource outcomes stay distinct from semantic acceptance.
source_specific_controls: all eight relationship forms retain source/target marker side and solid/dotted stroke
same-pair relationships remain separate occurrences with their own markers/labels
all 11 member rows retain owner, compartment, visibility, spelling, and order

theme_control_gap.required_before_claiming_theme_fidelity: Add an independently authorized style/color capture and theme-specific assertions for all four theme tokens; character-only PixelAt Grid comparison is insufficient.

---
description: >-
  Class diagram covering
  inheritance/composition/aggregation/association/link/dependency/realization
  relationship types plus member annotations, with an accTitle/accDescr pair,
  rendered under the "dark" theme via an in-body %%{init}%% directive.
---
%%{init: { 'logLevel': 0, 'theme': 'dark'} }%%
classDiagram
  accTitle: This is a title
  accDescr: This is a description

  Animal "*" <|-- "1" Duck
  Animal "1" <|-- "10" Fish
  Animal <|-- Zebra
  Animal : +int age
  Animal : +String gender
  Animal: +isMammal()
  Animal: +mate()
  class Duck{
    +String beakColor
    +swim()
    +quack()
  }
  class Fish{
    -int sizeInFeet
    -canEat()
  }
  class Zebra{
    +bool is_wild
    +run()
  }
classA <|-- classB
classC *-- classD
classE o-- classF
classG <-- classH
classI -- classJ
classK <.. classL
classM <|.. classN
classO .. classP
classA --|> classB : Inheritance
classC --* classD : Composition
classE --o classF : Aggregation
classG --> classH : Association
classI -- classJ : Link(Solid)
classK ..> classL : Dependency
classM ..|> classN : Realization
classO .. classP : Link(Dashed)
